title: ITRA — Grampians Peaks Trail 100 Miler 2026, GPT100 Miler race course
claims: ITRA dates the 2026 event 5-8 November 2026 and its event description calls the trail 164 km with 7,702 m of elevation from Mt Zero in the north to Dunkeld in the south.
ITRA lists the GPT100 Miler start as Mt Zero Picnic Area and the finish as Dunkeld Visitor Centre, with terrain of 98% paths, 2% tracks and 0% roads.
ITRA lists the 2026 event's races as GPT100 Miler, GPT100 Stage 2, Stage 3, Stage 4 and GPT50K.
